summary: Duel for Middle-earth is an asymmetric two-player card game where one player controls the Fellowship racing to destroy the Ring while the other plays Sauron hunting them down and building military strength. Games are tense and tactical, built around drafting cards from a shared market to fuel your engine each of the three chapters.
praised: tight two-player design from respected designers
criticised: can feel swingy or luck-dependent in card draws
learning both sides' strategies takes a few plays
market/drafting can create some analysis paralysis

interaction.kind: direct racing and combat with card drafting

scoring.why: winner is decided by completing the Fellowship's quest or Sauron stopping them, not by points

_name: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth
